subject: Lattice Link marketplace connector — escalation & SLA coordination
messages:
From: Sophie Grant <sophie@lattice-link.com>
To: partnership@redwood.ai, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: marketplace-ops@cloudmarket.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Spike in 503s from Redwood connector (Lattice Link marketplace)

Hi team,

We started seeing a spike of 5xx responses from the Redwood marketplace connector around 08:45 PT this morning. The ingestion queue for Lattice Link listings backed up and our downstream syncs are delayed. We collected a log bundle and some timestamps (attached).

Immediate asks:
- Can you confirm whether this is on Redwood's side or due to the marketplace throttle?
- We need an escalation contact and an ETA for mitigation — customer SLAs are impacted.

Attachment: connector-logs-20270518.tar.gz (tar.gz)

Thanks,
Sophie Grant
Head of Integrations | Lattice Link
S: +1 415-555-0190

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Grant <sophie@lattice-link.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 503s from Redwood connector (Lattice Link marketplace)

Hi Sophie — thanks for flagging and for the logs. We’re taking this seriously.

Immediate plan (quick triage):
1) Ben: can you pull host metrics and recent deploys for the connector (last 6 hrs)?
2) Camila: please spin up a bridge and invite Lattice Link engineering and the marketplace ops address.
3) Marissa: loop in the affected customers via a short status update template.
4) Sophie: if you can share the specific listing ids that failed, we’ll prioritize them.

On escalation/SLA: I want to confirm the formal escalation path so we can communicate timelines and any potential credit calculation. Ben — please run a root-cause hypothesis and indicate if this is a capacity/timeout or an upstream throttle.

I’ll be available on the bridge for the next 90 minutes.

— Vivek
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 503s from Redwood connector (Lattice Link marketplace)

Quick update from infra side — summary of checks I ran (attached minimal snippets):
- No recent deploys to connector cluster in the last 12 hrs.
- Pod restarts correlated with spike at 08:47 PT; three pods reported OOM-kill on the worker process.
- Observed increased latencies reaching the marketplace endpoint; retry loop amplified load.

Proposed immediate actions (short):
A) Increase connector worker pool by 20% for Lattice Link namespace (15m rollback window).
B) Enable circuit-breaker for marketplace calls to fail-fast after second retry.
C) Backpressure: pause non-critical syncs for 30 minutes and prioritize listings with highest traffic.
D) Gather a narrowed log bundle (uploader attached) for post-mortem.

Camila — please create the bridge and invite Sophie + eng@lattice-link.com. I’ve attached a short temp-runbook for the team to follow.

Attachments: temp-runbook-20270518.md

Regards,
Ben
Sr. Partner Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Grant <sophie@lattice-link.com>, eng@lattice-link.com, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, marketplace-ops@cloudmarket.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 503s from Redwood connector (Lattice Link marketplace)

Bridge created: https://zoom.us/j/6543219870 (starting now)

Runbook (temp):
- Step 1 (Ben): scale workers + monitor CPU/mem for 15m.
- Step 2 (Ben): enable fail-fast and reduce retry window.
- Step 3 (Sophie/LL eng): provide three listing IDs and any recent schema changes.
- Step 4 (Camila): if backlog not clearing, flip to fallback ingestion route (docs link in Drive).

I’ve attached the temp-runbook and requested the narrowed logs from infra. Will keep the bridge live for one hour and then schedule a post-incident meeting.

Attachments: temp-runbook-20270518.md

— Camila
Partner Support Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Sophie Grant <sophie@lattice-link.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: eng@lattice-link.com, marketplace-ops@cloudmarket.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 503s from Redwood connector (Lattice Link marketplace)

Thanks for the rapid response. We joined the bridge and validated Ben's scaling action reduced OOMs; backlog is slowly draining. Per the customers impacted, here are the listing ids we care about: LL-9932, LL-9951, LL-10008.

Two asks for escalation coordination:
1) We will need an estimate for SLA credit if the sync degradation is confirmed to be on Redwood's side — our legal/procurement team has requested a preliminary calculation for the impacted window (08:45–09:50 PT).
2) We want a written post-incident plan that clarifies: escalation contacts (phone + email), expected initial response SLA for P1 (15 mins), and how rollback/fallback is authorized.

I attached the log bundle and a short customer impact list.

Attachments: connector-logs-20270518.tar.gz, affected-customers-20270518.csv

Sophie

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Grant <sophie@lattice-link.com>, eng@lattice-link.com, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 14:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 503s from Redwood connector (Lattice Link marketplace)

Sophie — thank you and team for working through the bridge this morning. Summary and next steps below (for your procurement and legal teams):

Summary of findings:
- Root cause: connector worker process OOM under amplified retry load to marketplace endpoint. No infra deploy caused this; load pattern + retry policy exposed a latent memory leak in the worker.
- Mitigation performed: scaled worker pool (+20%), enabled fail-fast after 2 retries, paused low-priority syncs for 30 minutes. Backlog cleared by ~09:45 PT.

SLA / credit path:
- We will open a formal incident record and evaluate the impacted token/requests window (08:45–09:50 PT as you reported).
- Preliminary credit estimate: see attached proposed-sla-credit-matrix.xlsx (internal draft). Final credit requires full log parse and cross-check against customer usage; target to provide a firm number by EOD Friday (2027-05-21).

Escalation & operational commitments (agreed):
- P1 initial response window: 15 minutes (phone + bridge).
- P1 resolution target: 2 hours from detection for connector incidents (temporary mitigations may extend).
- Primary escalation contacts: Vivek Kulkarni (partnerships) + Ben Carter (partner reliability). Secondary: Camila Reyes (support ops). We will share direct numbers in a secured channel to your procurement team.
- Runbook: we’ll convert the temp-runbook into a persistent marketplace connector SLO & escalation doc and share within 72 hrs.

Immediate next steps:
1) Ben & Camila to deliver a post-mortem artifact and final log parse by EOD Wednesday (2027-05-19).
2) Vivek to deliver a written escalation contact list and the draft SLO doc by EOD Friday (2027-05-21).
3) Marissa will coordinate customer communication templates and share them with Lattice Link for approval.

If this timeline looks good, we’ll lock it and set a short follow-up to confirm the credit estimate and the final runbook.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
